categorias_que.rastreador: A public list recognises it as tracking: it is used to follow you from one site to the next.
categorias_que.publicidad: It is on the advertising lists: it shows you ads, or measures them.
categorias_que.telemetria: Usage data a program sends back to its maker.
categorias_que.esperado: What a machine needs to work: updates, time, messaging, video calls.
categorias_que.desconocido: No open tracking list knows it. It does not mean it is suspicious.
categorias_que.red_local: Devices in your home finding each other. It does not go out to the internet.
categorias_que.entrega: A network that carries other companies’ content. Not the destination: the road.
categorias_que.de_empresa: Its owner is known (the next column names the company) and no list marks it as tracking or advertising, but the name does not say what it is for. A label, never a verdict.
categorias_que.pista_anuncios: No list has it yet, but the name carries a technical term from ad auctions (prebid, rtb, ssp, dsp, cookie syncing). The name says so; it is not a verdict.
categorias_que.pista_pago: A payment or a subscription at that company: the name carries “checkout”, “pay”, “billing” or similar. The name says so; it is not a verdict.
categorias_que.pista_cuenta: Signing in or your account data at that company: the name carries “login”, “accounts”, “auth” or similar. The name says so; it is not a verdict.
categorias_que.pista_medicion: Counts what you do in its app or site, for the company itself: the name carries “analytics”, “metrics”, “events”, “pixel” or similar. No public list marks it as tracking; the name says so.
categorias_que.pista_notificaciones: The notifications that reach your device: the name carries “push”, “notifications” or similar. The name says so; it is not a verdict.
categorias_que.pista_actualizaciones: Downloading updates or the installer: the name carries “update”, “download”, “release” or similar. The name says so; it is not a verdict.
categorias_que.pista_seguridad: Security checks of the browser or the system: the name carries “safebrowsing”, “smartscreen”, “captcha” or similar. The name says so; it is not a verdict.
categorias_que.pista_correo: Your email: the name carries “mail”, “smtp” or “imap”. The name says so; it is not a verdict.
categorias_que.pista_mensajes: Chat or messaging of that company: the name carries “chat”, “messages” or similar. The name says so; it is not a verdict.
categorias_que.pista_sincronizacion: Syncs or keeps a copy in the cloud: the name carries “drive” or “backup”. The name says so; it is not a verdict.
categorias_que.pista_contenido: Images, video, files or fonts the page needs to display: the name carries “cdn”, “static”, “img”, “media” or similar. The name says so; it is not a verdict.
categorias_que.pista_configuracion: The program asks for its settings or checks options: the name carries “config”, “settings”, “flags” or similar. The name says so; it is not a verdict.
categorias_que.pista_app: The program or app talking to its own company’s server in order to work: the name carries “api”, “gateway”, “backend” or similar. The name says so; it is not a verdict.
categorias_que.pista_web: That company’s site or app, the one you opened: the name is its domain or starts with “www”. The name says so; it is not a verdict.
categorias_que.sector: A {sector} website: what it does, from our open list of sectors. It says what it is, not whether to trust it.

senales.baliza: Contacts the same destination every {n} minutes, like a heartbeat.
senales.destino_nuevo: This device had never looked up this service before.
senales.fuera_de_horas: Talks at hours when this device usually does not.
senales.evasion_dns: Tries to resolve names on its own, out of GUARDIANA’s sight.
senales.volumen: Is asking far more than usual.

cli.observe.arrancando: GUARDIANA is watching. Name → category → device. Ctrl+C to stop.
cli.observe.sin_privilegios: Listening on port 53 needs administrator rights (sudo).
cli.observe.limite_mac: On macOS, changing the system DNS needs administrator rights: the GUARDIANA desktop app asks for them and the panel makes the change.
cli.ledger.ok_recortado: Chain verified: {n} events correct; {p} earlier ones already summarised by retention.
cli.ledger.fallo: The chain is broken at event {id}: {motivo}.
cli.ledger.fallo.enlace: does not link to the previous event
cli.ledger.fallo.alterado: its data does not match its hash
cli.ledger.fallo.recortado: the most recent events are missing from here on
cli.ledger.fallo.sin_cabeza: the record of where the chain ends is missing, so there is no telling whether the latest events were removed
cli.dns.deshacer_pendiente: The change failed half-way and could not be fully undone. The copy of your previous setting is still saved: run guardiana dns --restore to put it back.
cli.observe.no_comparte: Queries from {dispositivo} are recorded but not shown here: its owner does not share the detail with the home panel.
cli.observe.vuelve_licencia: The licence is valid again: GUARDIANA is this computer's DNS again and is watching.
cli.observe.vuelve_licencia_sin_dns: The licence is valid again: GUARDIANA is watching again.
cli.observe.vuelve_hogar: Home Mode is on again, as you had it.
cli.observe.relevo: Home Mode: the router still sends the house's queries here. While GUARDIANA stands aside it only passes them on to {upstream} from {addr}, without looking at them or writing them down, so nobody is left without internet. Put the router's DNS back as it was (or to automatic) when you can.
cli.observe.relevo_sin_arriba: Home Mode: I cannot find where to pass the house's queries on, so I cannot relay them. If the router still sends the home's queries here, put its DNS back as it was (or to automatic) now: without that, the phones and the rest are left without internet.
cli.observe.relevo_error: Home Mode: I cannot listen on the network to pass the house's queries on ({error}). If the router still sends the home's queries here, put its DNS back as it was (or to automatic) now.
cli.observe.upstream_propio: The DNS the network hands out is this very computer (the router gives out its address, as Home Mode asks), and GUARDIANA cannot ask itself: it asks {servers}.
cli.observe.solo_propio: The only DNS this computer knows is itself (the router gives out its address, as Home Mode asks), and GUARDIANA cannot ask itself. Set a fixed DNS on this computer (the router's or your provider's) or give one with --upstream IP.
cli.ledger.wipe.confirmar: This deletes the whole ledger, the devices, the rules and the record of connections. Type DELETE to confirm:
cli.ledger.wipe.hecho: Ledger deleted. GUARDIANA starts from zero.
cli.uso:
Usage:
  guardiana observe [--listen IP:PORT] [--upstream IP[:PORT]]... [--db PATH] [--canary] [--open] [--no-panel] [--panel-listen IP:PORT]
  guardiana ledger [--check | --wipe | --self | --last N] [--db PATH]
  guardiana export [--csv | --json] [--out FILE] [--device ID] [--category C] [--signal S] [--verdict V] [--limit N] [--db PATH]
  guardiana dns [--status | --apply --yes | --restore] [--db PATH]
  guardiana licencia [clave KEY | comprobar]
  guardiana trampa [crear | lista | quitar ID]   (trap files: a name that only exists inside)
  guardiana apps [--seconds N] [--crudo]   (Windows: which program asks for each name, watch only)
  guardiana verify [--json]
  guardiana reglas [deshacer ID | deshacer-hoy]
  guardiana informe               (weekly home report)
  guardiana hogar [status | on | off]
  guardiana service [install | uninstall | start | stop | status]
  guardiana panel                (opens the panel in the browser)
  guardiana menu [--choice N]     (interactive test menu)
  guardiana version
cli.observe.upstream_auto: Upstream resolver taken from the system ({fuente}).
cli.observe.sin_upstream: Cannot find the system resolver. Give one with --upstream IP.
cli.observe.bucle: The upstream resolver cannot be the same address GUARDIANA listens on.
cli.observe.parado: GUARDIANA has stopped watching. {n} queries recorded in this session.
cli.observe.parado_uno: GUARDIANA has stopped watching. 1 query recorded in this session.
cli.observe.clave_dev: Notice: this binary carries the development key, not the release key.
cli.ledger.sin_extracto: No ledger yet at {ruta}. Run guardiana observe first.
cli.ledger.cabecera: time (UTC)  name  →  category  →  device  ·  state  ·  signals
cli.ledger.self.vacio: GUARDIANA has sent nothing out of this machine.
cli.ledger.self.cabecera: Connections GUARDIANA made by itself (all started by you):
cli.dns.estado.sin_resolutor: Cannot find any resolver configured on the system.
cli.dns.estado.aplicado: GUARDIANA has been the system DNS since {fecha}. A copy of the previous setting is saved.
cli.dns.estado.no_aplicado: GUARDIANA has not changed the system DNS.
cli.dns.consentimiento: This changes this machine's DNS so that its queries go through GUARDIANA (127.0.0.1). An exact copy of the previous setting is saved and put back as it was with guardiana dns --restore.
cli.dns.aplicado: Done. This machine now resolves through GUARDIANA (127.0.0.1). It used to resolve with: {originales}. Undo: guardiana dns --restore.
cli.dns.ya_aplicado: GUARDIANA is already set as the DNS. To go back: guardiana dns --restore.
cli.dns.restaurando: Restoring the previous DNS of {n} interface(s)...
cli.dns.restaurado: System DNS restored exactly as it was.
cli.dns.no_hay_copia: There is no change by GUARDIANA to undo.
cli.dns.sin_admin: Changing the system DNS needs administrator rights. On Windows, open the terminal with “Run as administrator”; on Linux and Mac, type the command with sudo in front.
cli.dns.aparcada_borrada: GUARDIANA had already given the DNS back as it was when it stood aside. Noted: when it watches again, it will not change it.
cli.dns.no_soportado: Changing the system DNS is only available on Windows, Linux and, with administrator rights, macOS.
cli.uso.doble_clic: This program is run from a terminal, or with the double-click files that come with it (1-observar, 2-preguntar, 3-ver-cuaderno).
cli.uso.pulsa_intro: Press Enter to close this window.
cli.observe.upstream_copia: Upstream resolver taken from the copy saved before the DNS was changed: {servers}.
cli.observe.panel_nota: That link carries the key of your session; do not share it. Without it the panel shows nothing.
cli.observe.panel_error: The panel could not start: {error}. GUARDIANA keeps watching without a panel.
cli.observe.retencion: Everything is kept while the program is active. Nothing is deleted on its own.
cli.menu.opciones:
1  Watch in test mode (changes nothing) and open the panel
  2  See the ledger
  3  Watch for real: change this machine's DNS, with your permission
  4  Undo the DNS change
  5  DNS status
  6  Home Mode: turn on
  7  Home Mode: turn off
  8  Home Mode: status
  9  Service: install (GUARDIANA starts with Windows and watches without a window)
 10  Service: remove

cli.menu.elige: Choose a number and press Enter:
cli.menu.no_entiendo: I did not understand the option. Type only the number.
cli.menu.volver: Press Enter to go back to the menu.
cli.menu.admin_necesario: This option changes system settings and needs administrator permission. Windows will ask you in a new window; press Yes.
cli.menu.admin_lanzado: Another window opened with administrator rights. Continue there; this one can stay open.
cli.menu.admin_fallo: Could not ask for administrator permission. Close this, right-click guardiana.exe and choose “Run as administrator”.
cli.menu.self_test: Sending six test questions to GUARDIANA...
cli.menu.self_test_hecho: Test questions sent. They should show above and in the panel.
cli.menu.parar: To stop and go back to the menu: press Ctrl+C.
cli.menu.confirmar_si: Type YES (in capitals) and press Enter to accept, or anything else to change nothing:
cli.menu.ya_servicio: GUARDIANA is already installed as a service and watches this machine without a window: this option is not needed and changes nothing. To see it, open the panel (option 11).
cli.menu.navega: GUARDIANA now watches everything this machine does. Open the browser, visit a couple of websites, and look here and in the panel.
cli.hogar.estado.on: Home Mode: on since {fecha}. Local network IP: {ip}.
cli.hogar.estado.off: Home Mode: off. No port open towards the network.
cli.hogar.estado.fuera: Home Mode: on since {fecha}, but paused: this computer is not on the network where you switched it on. It comes back by itself at home; if you moved or changed routers, “guardiana hogar on” as administrator (with sudo on Linux) takes this network as home.
cli.hogar.estado.aparcado: Home Mode: set aside, because GUARDIANA stands aside (the trial or the subscription ended). The router still sends the home's queries here and GUARDIANA only passes them on, without looking. It comes back on by itself with the licence; “guardiana hogar off” switches it off completely.
cli.hogar.on.hecho: Home Mode on. IP {ip}. GUARDIANA opens the ports on the local network in under a minute.
cli.hogar.off.hecho: Home Mode off. In under a minute GUARDIANA will listen only on this PC.
cli.hogar.qr: Phones scan the QR in the panel, Home Mode page: {url}
cli.observe.hogar: Home Mode: also listening on {addr} (DNS) and {panel} (panel). Firefox canary on.
cli.observe.hogar_no_privada: Home Mode requested, but the address {ip} is not on a private network. Nothing is opened outwards.
cli.observe.hogar_otra_red: Home Mode paused: this computer is not on the network where you switched it on. Away from home it opens no port towards the network; it comes back by itself when you are home again.
cli.observe.hueco: GUARDIANA was not watching between {desde} and {hasta}. It is on record.
cli.servicio.instalado: Service installed. GUARDIANA will start with the system and is already running. Panel: option 11 of the menu or guardiana panel.
cli.servicio.quitado: Service removed. GUARDIANA no longer starts with the system.
cli.apps.escuchando: Listening for {s} seconds to what Windows says about its own queries. Nothing is stored and nothing is blocked: this only looks.
cli.ia_programa_titulo: The program that made those queries, according to Windows itself. Only on this computer: from a phone in Home Mode you see the service name and nothing else.
cli.trampa_frase: This name only exists inside one of your trap files. GUARDIANA did not open that file or any other: all it saw is that something asked for this name, and that name cannot be known without having read the file.
cli.trampa.uso: I do not know “{cmd}”. Try: guardiana trampa crear | lista | quitar <id>
cli.trampa.creada:
Trap placed at {archivo}
If any program reads that file and looks up {nombre}, it will be written in the ledger with the time and, on Windows, with the program's name.
cli.trampa.falta_id: Which one? guardiana trampa quitar <id>. The list is in: guardiana trampa lista
cli.trampa.no_esta: There is no trap with the id {id}.
cli.trampa.ninguna: No traps placed. Place one with: guardiana trampa crear
cli.trampa.intacta: Nobody has asked for it yet.
cli.trampa.ya_hay: There is already a trap in that file: {archivo} [{id}]. Two in the same file do not work, because the second one covers the first. Remove the old one with: guardiana trampa quitar {id}
cli.trampa.sin_archivo: The file is gone: this trap cannot spring. Remove it with “guardiana trampa quitar {id}” or create it again.
cli.trampa.picada: SPRUNG: asked {n} time(s). The first, on {fecha}, by {quien}.
cli.trampa.sin_programa: a program the system could not name
cli.apps.fin: Done. Queries with a known program: {n}.
cli.servicio.estado.stopped_motivo: Service: installed but stopped. The last time it tried to start, it said this: {motivo}
cli.servicio.estado.none: Service: not installed. GUARDIANA only works while this window is open.
cli.servicio.privilegios: Installing, removing or stopping the service needs administrator permission.
cli.servicio.no_soportado: The service only exists on Windows, Linux and macOS.
cli.servicio.dns_aviso: The service watches for real only if the system DNS points at GUARDIANA (option 3 or guardiana dns --apply --yes). Otherwise it only watches what it is asked.
cli.panel.sin_token: Cannot find the panel key at {ruta}. Is GUARDIANA running (service or option 1/3)?
cli.panel.sin_permiso: The panel key is kept by the service at {ruta} and only the administrator can read it. Type “sudo guardiana panel”: it gives you the link to open in your browser.
cli.panel.sin_permiso_windows: Windows will not let this user read the panel key ({ruta}). Open the Start menu, look for “GUARDIANA” and open it from there, or open “Command Prompt” with “Run as administrator” and type “guardiana panel”.
cli.panel.enlace_sudo: Open this link in your browser (it carries your session key; do not share it): {url}
cli.panel.esperando: GUARDIANA is starting. The panel opens by itself as soon as the service answers.
cli.observe.puerto80: Could not open {addr} for the checker page ({motivo}). Phones can use http://{addr}:7443/mi-dispositivo.
cli.informe.fila: {nombre}: {consultas} queries, of which {rastreadores} to trackers, {publicidad} to advertising, {esperados} normal and {cortados} blocked
cli.informe.total: Total: {consultas} queries, of which {rastreadores} to trackers, {publicidad} to advertising and {cortados} blocked
cli.reglas.cabecera: Rules (id, state, scope, type:pattern, action, device, created):
cli.reglas.ninguna: There are no rules. GUARDIANA only watches.
cli.reglas.deshecha: Rule undone. The record is kept.
cli.reglas.no_encontrada: There is no active rule with that number.
cli.reglas.numero_malo: “{id}” is not a rule number. The numbers are shown by “guardiana reglas”.
cli.verify.firma.dev: Signature: this program carries the DEVELOPMENT key, not the release key. There is no signature to check; it is not a released version.
cli.verify.firma.sin_archivo: Signature: not found. Download {archivo} from the install page into a folder and run verify from that folder: it checks the signature on your computer, without connecting to anything.
cli.verify.firma.sin_archivo_panel: Signature: the panel cannot check it, because the service does not see your downloads folder. Download {archivo} from the install page, open a terminal in that folder and type “guardiana verify”: it checks the signature on your machine, without connecting to anything.
cli.verify.firma.mac_zip: Signature: on a Mac what is published and signed is the .zip you downloaded, not the program inside it, so there is no signature to look for here. Check the .zip's with minisign, as the install page explains.
cli.verify.registro.sin_archivo_panel: Public ledger: the panel cannot look up the fingerprint, because the service does not see your downloads folder. Download ledger.jsonl from the install page, open a terminal in that folder and type “guardiana verify”.
cli.verify.firma.ok: Signature: correct. The program is signed with the GUARDIANA key it carries inside: {clave}. Compare it with the one published at guardianagroup.com/en/install.html.
cli.verify.firma.mal: Signature: does NOT match. The program or its signature has changed. Do not use it until this is cleared up.
cli.verify.registro.sin_archivo: Public ledger: there is no ledger.jsonl in this folder or next to the program. Download it from the install page into the same folder and run verify from there: it looks this fingerprint up in the public ledger, on your computer.
cli.verify.registro.no_esta: Public ledger: this fingerprint is NOT in ledger.jsonl. If this is a released version, something is off.
cli.verify.registro.ok: Public ledger: matches version {v} published on {fecha} (Rekor {rekor}).
cli.verify.dns.guardiana_primario: GUARDIANA changed the DNS: this machine's queries go through it.
cli.verify.dns.guardiana_no_primario: GUARDIANA changed the DNS but RIGHT NOW the queries do not go through it: the system changed it back. The service reapplies it every minute; if it persists, use guardiana dns --apply --yes.
cli.verify.dns.guardiana_desconocido: GUARDIANA changed the DNS; could not check whether the queries go through it right now.
cli.verify.dns.sin_cambiar: GUARDIANA has not changed the system DNS.
cli.extracto.otra_clave: This ledger does not belong to this version of GUARDIANA: it was created by a version signed with a different key, and, for safety, the two are never mixed. If you are coming from a test version, move the ledger file elsewhere and GUARDIANA will start a new one. If you were not expecting this, delete nothing and write to hola@guardianagroup.com.
cli.verify.dns.solo_guardiana_sin_copia: System DNS: GUARDIANA (127.0.0.1) and nothing else. Every query from this machine goes through it.
cli.verify.dns.solo_guardiana_ajustes: System DNS: only GUARDIANA (127.0.0.1), according to the settings. Whether queries really arrive is what the check below says.
cli.verify.dns.apunta_sin_copia: This machine points at GUARDIANA, but GUARDIANA did not make that change: it has no record of the DNS you had before. On uninstall it will not be able to put it back exactly as it was. Apply it again from the panel so it is recorded.
cli.verify.vigilante: Guard Mode on for: {aparatos}. On those devices everything outside the declared scope is blocked, not only what the agent asks for.
cli.verify.hogar.aparcado: Home Mode: set aside, because the trial or the subscription ended. While GUARDIANA stands aside, port 53 stays open on the local network: it passes the house's queries on, without looking at them or writing them down, so nobody is left without internet until you put the router's DNS back.
cli.verify.puertos.ninguno: Ports open towards the local network: none.
cli.verify.puertos.abiertos: GUARDIANA ports open towards the local network: {puertos}.
cli.verify.puertos.no_leidos: Ports: could not read the system's list of ports.
cli.verify.puertos.aviso: WARNING: Home Mode is off and there are GUARDIANA ports open towards the network. Wait a minute and check again; if it stays like this, tell us.
cli.verify.lista: List {id}: {n} entries, shipped inside the program; fetched on {fecha}.
cli.verify.cadena.mal: Ledger: the chain is BROKEN. See guardiana ledger --check.
cli.verify.extracto.sin_permiso: GUARDIANA may have changed the DNS, but this user cannot check it: only the administrator can read the ledger. Run it again with sudo (on Windows, “Run as administrator”).
cli.cli.extracto.sin_permiso: I cannot open this machine's ledger: it belongs to the administrator. Run the command again with sudo (on Windows, “Run as administrator”).
cli.verify.cadena.sin_permiso: Ledger: it is there, but this user cannot read it. With sudo you get the event count and the chain check.
cli.observe.reconfigurando: Change in the home network or in Home Mode: GUARDIANA reopens its ports without stopping.
cli.observe.sin_arriba: The DNS of your network ({upstream}) has not answered for a minute. GUARDIANA gives this computer its DNS back as it was, so you keep your internet, and will ask again every minute.
cli.observe.vuelve_arriba: The DNS of your network answers again: GUARDIANA is this computer’s DNS once more.
cli.dns.estado.guardiana_primero: This machine's queries go to GUARDIANA (127.0.0.1).
cli.dns.aplicado_panel: Done. This PC now goes through GUARDIANA (127.0.0.1). It used to resolve with: {originales}. It can be undone in “Status”.
cli.dns.consentimiento_si: To accept, repeat the command with --yes.
cli.dns.reserva_secundario: The resolver you have now stays as the secondary: if GUARDIANA stops, the machine keeps resolving through it.
cli.dns.solo_guardiana: On this machine GUARDIANA becomes the only resolver. That is what stops any query that goes through the system DNS slipping past it: systemd-resolved picks among the servers it has, it does not ask them in order, so leaving the old one as a second would mean part of the queries would never be seen. The service comes back by itself if it stops, and guardiana dns --restore puts everything back exactly as it was.
cli.dns.solo_guardiana_windows: On this machine GUARDIANA becomes the only DNS, over IPv6 too. That way no query that goes through the system DNS slips past it, and Edge does not go off to an encrypted DNS of its own. GUARDIANA keeps asking the servers you had, from the inside. If the service stops, the machine gets its previous DNS back until it starts again, and uninstalling leaves it exactly as it was.
cli.dns.solo_guardiana_mac: On this Mac GUARDIANA becomes the only DNS. That way no query that goes through the system DNS slips past it, and Chrome or Edge do not go off on their own to an encrypted DNS. GUARDIANA keeps asking the network's servers behind the scenes. If the service stops, the Mac gets its previous DNS back until it starts again, and uninstalling leaves it exactly as it was.
cli.dns.camino_ok: Checked: a query made by Windows just now reached GUARDIANA.
cli.dns.camino_no: WARNING: a query made by Windows just now did NOT reach GUARDIANA, so you will not see anything yet. Disconnect the Wi-Fi and connect it again (or restart) and check again in “Verify”. If it stays like this, write to hola@guardianagroup.com.
cli.verify.dns.guardiana_con_reserva: System DNS: GUARDIANA (127.0.0.1), with {dns} as the fallback. If GUARDIANA stops, the machine asks the fallback and those queries are not written down.
cli.verify.dns.por_guardiana: System DNS: GUARDIANA (127.0.0.1), which forwards to {dns}.
cli.verify.dns.camino_ok: Real test: a query made by the system just now reached GUARDIANA.
cli.verify.dns.camino_no: Real test: a query made by the system just now did NOT reach GUARDIANA.
cli.observe.caducado: The trial is over and there is no active subscription. GUARDIANA has put this machine’s DNS back exactly as it was and has stopped watching: your internet keeps working the same. Your ledger is whole on your disk and you can take it with you. To watch again, activate Plus in the panel.
cli.observe.caducado_plus: The subscription has ended. GUARDIANA has put this machine's DNS back as it was and has stopped watching: your internet keeps working the same. The ledger is whole on your disk and you can take it. To watch again, activate your key in the panel.
cli.verify.dns.camino_no.parado: The GUARDIANA service is stopped and the settings still point at it, so nothing answers: start the service (guardiana service start) or give back the previous DNS with guardiana dns --restore.
cli.verify.dns.camino_no.sin_servicio: GUARDIANA is not installed as a service and the settings still point at it, so nothing answers: give back the previous DNS with guardiana dns --restore.
cli.verify.dns.camino_no.ajustes: The settings point at GUARDIANA but the system resolves another way. Disconnect the network and connect it again, or restart; if it stays like this, write to us.
cli.verify.dns.guardiana_apunta: The DNS settings point at GUARDIANA (127.0.0.1).
cli.verify.dns.guardiana_no_primario_parado: The service is stopped and, as it always does when it stops, it gave this machine its previous DNS back. It keeps the copy: when it starts, it steps in front again.
cli.verify.dns.guardiana_apartada: GUARDIANA stepped aside on its own because its upstream servers are not answering, so you are not left without internet. It comes back by itself as soon as they answer.
cli.verify.registro.mac_sin_archivo: Public ledger: there is no ledger.jsonl on this machine. On a Mac the public ledger lists the .zip you downloaded, not the program inside it: compare that .zip's fingerprint with the one on the website.
cli.verify.registro.mac_zip: Public ledger: on a Mac the public ledger lists the .zip you downloaded, not the program inside it, so this fingerprint cannot be in it. Compare the .zip's fingerprint with the one on the website.
cli.verify.registro.mac_zip_huella: Public ledger: on a Mac the public ledger lists the .zip, not the program inside it. This version's is {archivo}, fingerprint {sha}: compare it with the .zip you downloaded.
cli.verify.puertos.de_otros: Other programs hold these ports open towards the local network; they are not GUARDIANA's: {puertos}.
cli.verify.puertos.dueno_desconocido: These ports are open towards the local network by a program the system will not name without administrator rights: {puertos}. They are not put down to GUARDIANA; to see whose they are, run verify again as administrator.
cli.observe.hogar_puerto_ocupado: Home Mode: {addr} could not be opened for the home's devices (another program holds it or the address changed). This computer is still watched; it is tried again at the next check.
cli.observe.resolutor_caido: The resolver stopped answering on its own; GUARDIANA brings it back up.
cli.panel.tarda: This is taking longer than usual. If it does not open within a minute, open the Start menu, look for “GUARDIANA” and open it from there.
cli.panel.abriendo_espera: GUARDIANA is starting: the browser opens the panel as soon as it answers.

panel.pie: GUARDIANA runs entirely on this machine. There is no account, no server of ours, and it sends nothing you do not trigger yourself.
panel.sin_sesion_texto: Open the panel from the GUARDIANA launcher (or from the guardiana observe window), which includes the session key. The key lives only in memory and is not stored as a cookie.
panel.radiografia_lead: Which services this machine is trying to talk to right now, with their category and one sentence per signal. Real figures from the ledger, no rounding.
panel.radiografia_limite: GUARDIANA sees service names and, on Windows, which program on this computer asked for them; never what content was sent. It never says “malicious”: it says what it observed.
panel.trampa_frase: This name only exists inside one of your trap files. GUARDIANA did not open that file or any other: all it saw is that something asked for this name, and that name cannot be known without having read the file.
panel.ia_programa_titulo: The program that made those queries, according to Windows itself. Only on this computer: from a phone in Home Mode you see the service name and nothing else.
panel.sin_consultas_aun: No queries yet. Browse a little and they will show up here.
panel.extracto_lead: Every query on record, with who decided what. Filter, export and verify the chain.
panel.mostrando_ocultos: Another {n} belong to devices that do not share their detail with the home panel: they are counted, not shown.
panel.mostrando_ocultos_uno: One more belongs to a device that does not share its detail with the home panel: it is counted, not shown.
panel.reglas_ocultas: There are {n} more rules that devices set for themselves and that do not share their detail: they are counted, not shown.
panel.reglas_ocultas_uno: There is 1 more rule that a device set for itself and that does not share its detail: it is counted, not shown.
panel.mi_por_ip: This device is known by its address on the network, not by its hardware address. If the router gives this address to another device, that one will see this history from here and inherit this checkbox as it is.
panel.cadena_lead: Every entry carries the fingerprint of the previous one. If someone deleted or changed a line, it shows here.
panel.cadena_ok_recortada: Chain verified: {n} events correct; {p} earlier ones already summarised by retention.
panel.cadena_rota: The chain is broken at event {id}: {motivo}.
panel.dispositivos_lead: Totals per device. A device's detail is visible only from that device, unless its owner shares it.
panel.dispositivos_limite: Until Home Mode is on, only this PC appears here. In Home Mode, GUARDIANA sees service names, not which app asked for them.
panel.sabe_lead: Everything this program stores, where it stores it, and everything it has sent out of this machine.
panel.s_no_respuestas: Only queries are recorded: name, type, device, time, category and verdict; on Windows, for this computer's own, also which program asked: its name, its path on disk (which may include your user name) and the file's fingerprint. Never the answers, never the content.
panel.retencion_ilimitada: no limit: nothing is deleted, not even when you stop paying
panel.outbound_lead: Every connection the program made by itself: activating the licence and the subscription check (8 days after activating it and once per period). There is no other: the lists ship inside the program and new versions are installed by you. With whom, when and how many bytes.
panel.outbound_vacio: GUARDIANA has sent nothing out of this machine.
panel.borrar_lead: Deletes the ledger, the devices, the rules and this record. It cannot be undone.
panel.borrar_confirmar: This deletes everything and cannot be undone. Type DELETE to confirm:
panel.clave_dev: development key, not the release key
panel.dns_aplicado_falta: pointed at GUARDIANA, except a connection that is asking another DNS right now (a new network or adapter, or GUARDIANA set aside because the network was not answering). It points it back by itself as soon as it can, usually within a minute.
panel.estado_limite: Home Mode is not part of version 1.0 on a Mac: GUARDIANA does not manage the macOS firewall and it has not been tested there the way it was on Windows and Linux. Changing the system DNS and the service that starts by itself do work on all three.
panel.hogar_lead: Turns this PC into the DNS guardian of the home Wi‑Fi: phones, TV and everything that uses the Wi‑Fi, without installing anything on them.
panel.hogar_estado_on: Home Mode on since {fecha}. GUARDIANA listens on the IP {ip} of your local network.
panel.hogar_estado_fuera: Home Mode is on, but paused: this computer is not on the network where you switched it on, and away from home it opens no port towards the network. It comes back by itself when you are home. If you moved or changed routers, switch it off and on again here.
panel.hogar_estado_off: Home Mode off. GUARDIANA listens only on this PC; no port open towards the network.
panel.hogar_estado_aparcado: Home Mode set aside: the trial or the subscription ended. Your router still sends the home's queries here, so GUARDIANA only passes them on, without looking at them or writing them down. It comes back on by itself if you activate Plus.
panel.hogar_desactivar_relevo: Switch off completely (I put the router's DNS back)
panel.hogar_que_pasa: When turned on, GUARDIANA opens ports only on your local network, never towards the internet: the DNS (53), this panel (7443) and the checker page (80). It is recorded in the ledger. Turning it off closes them. The change takes under a minute; if the Wi‑Fi connects later or changes address, GUARDIANA notices by itself.
panel.hogar_ip_dinamica: Notice: the IP {ip} of this PC is assigned by the router and may change. If it changes, the phones would lose their DNS. Reserve this IP for this PC in the router (“DHCP reservation”, usually under Local network › DHCP) or set a fixed IP.
panel.hogar_ip_fija: The IP {ip} of this PC looks fixed. Good.
panel.hogar_ip_desconocida: Could not tell whether the IP {ip} is fixed or assigned by the router. If it changes, the phones would lose their DNS: better reserve it in the router.
panel.hogar_qr_lead: Scan this code with the phone: it opens the step-by-step guide in this panel and a checker.
panel.hogar_url: Or type in the phone's browser:
panel.hogar_router_texto: In the router, under the DHCP settings, set the IP {ip} as the DNS server. Every device on the Wi‑Fi is covered without touching them. If the provider's router does not allow it, use the per-phone guide.
panel.hogar_iphone_pasos: Settings › Wi‑Fi › tap the (i) of your network › Configure DNS › Manual › Add Server › type {ip} › Save. Remove the other servers from the list.
panel.hogar_android_pasos: Settings › Wi‑Fi › long-press your network › Modify › Advanced options › IP settings: Static › DNS 1: {ip}. Many Android phones also require a fixed IP for the phone: pick a free one on your network (for example the one it already has) and leave the rest as it is.
panel.hogar_comprobar_texto: On the phone, open http://comprobar.guardiana.hogar . If the page “This device already goes through GUARDIANA” loads, it is done. Only GUARDIANA resolves that name.
panel.hogar_prueba: Home Mode has no limit of its own: it goes with the licence, like everything else. What matters is that this PC is on.
panel.hogar_limite: Only on the home Wi‑Fi. On mobile data or away from home, the phone does not go through GUARDIANA. GUARDIANA sees service names, not which app asked for them. Coverage away from home: coming later. If this PC shuts down or sleeps, phones pointing only at it are left without DNS until it comes back.
panel.hogar_no_admin: Opening the ports and the firewall rule requires running GUARDIANA as administrator.
panel.hogar_firewall_manual: On this system the firewall rule is added by hand, and only if you have one running: let in, from your local network, ports 53 (udp and tcp), 7443/tcp (the phones' panel) and 80/tcp (the check page). With ufw: sudo ufw allow from 192.168.0.0/16 to any port 53 && sudo ufw allow from 192.168.0.0/16 to any port 7443 proto tcp && sudo ufw allow from 192.168.0.0/16 to any port 80 proto tcp (if your network starts with 10., use 10.0.0.0/8 instead of 192.168.0.0/16). With firewalld, in your Wi-Fi's zone (see it with “firewall-cmd --get-active-zones”; here, home): sudo firewall-cmd --permanent --zone=home --add-service=dns --add-port=7443/tcp --add-port=80/tcp && sudo firewall-cmd --reload.
panel.hogar_sin_lan: Cannot find a local network address. Connect this PC to the Wi‑Fi or the router and try again.
panel.mi_lead: What GUARDIANA has recorded about this device, identified by its address on the Wi‑Fi.
panel.mi_consentimiento: This network uses GUARDIANA. This is what is recorded about this device: service names, time, category. No apps, no content.
panel.mi_compartir: Share my detail with the home panel
panel.mi_compartir_texto: Off: the home panel only sees totals for this device. On: the detail too.
panel.mi_pasa: This device already goes through GUARDIANA.
panel.mi_no_pasa: This device has not sent any query to GUARDIANA yet. Follow the guide on the Home Mode page.
panel.mi_no_lan: This page is for the devices on the Wi‑Fi. From this PC, use Snapshot.
panel.comprobador_titulo: This device already goes through GUARDIANA
panel.comprobador_texto: You got here because the name comprobar.guardiana.hogar was resolved by GUARDIANA. This device's queries are now recorded on the home Wi‑Fi.
panel.informe_lead: The last seven days, per device, with real figures from the ledger. Nothing leaves home unless you share it.
panel.informe_whatsapp_titulo: Text ready for WhatsApp or email
panel.informe_whatsapp_lead: Your WhatsApp or your email opens with the text already written. GUARDIANA sends nothing: you send it, if you want.
panel.informe_texto: This week, at home: {dispositivos} and {consultas} queries, of which {rastreadores} to trackers, {publicidad} to advertising and {cortados} blocked. Recorded by GUARDIANA, at home, without sending anything to anyone.
panel.informe_sin_datos: There is not a week of data yet. The report fills itself in.
panel.informe_apartado: GUARDIANA is not watching (the trial or the subscription ended), so there is no report for this week. What was already written down is still in the ledger.
panel.informe_comparar_desde: Comparing with last week, and telling which destinations are new, needs a whole week of watching before this one. It will be here from {fecha}.
panel.informe_limite: Counts queries by service name, not traffic or content. “Tracker” and “advertising” come from open lists; “normal” means updates, time, messaging and video calls. No figure is rounded.
panel.compartir_lead: A card with the totals right now, with no service names. It is made in your browser; nothing is sent.
panel.compartir_texto: 60-second snapshot with GUARDIANA: {servicios} services, {rastreadores} trackers, {nuevos} new destinations, {esperados} normal, {cortados} blocked. All recorded at home, without sending anything to anyone.
panel.tarjeta_pie: GUARDIANA · recorded at home, without sending anything to anyone
panel.reglas_titulo: Rules: what is blocked and what is allowed
panel.reglas_lead: No rule exists unless you create it. Every block records who decided it and when. Undoing never deletes: it records that it was undone.
panel.reglas_inviolables: Broad rules wait and respect the essentials: a whole category, the whole home or Guard Mode block nothing until GUARDIANA has watched for 24 hours, and never touch system updates, time, certificates, connectivity checks, recognised messaging and video calls, or what GUARDIANA itself needs. One name you pick is blocked from the first minute; if it is one of those essentials, or the device has been watched for less than a day, you are asked first.
panel.reglas_nueva_lead: Block or allow an exact name, a family of names (the domain and everything under it) or a whole category, for one device or for the whole home.
panel.reglas_ninguna: There are no rules. GUARDIANA only watches.
panel.leyenda_desconocido: “Local network” is the devices of your home finding each other: it does not go out to the internet. “Delivery” is a network that carries other companies’ content: not the destination, the road. “Its site”, “your account”, “its server”, “content”, “settings”, “measurement”… is what the name itself says (www, login, api, cdn, config, analytics…): a hint, not a check. “Service” is a name of a known company that no list marks and whose name does not say what it is for. “Unclassified” means neither any public list nor our company list knows it; not that it is suspicious. “Sport”, “news”, “banking”… is what a well-known website does, from our open list of sectors.
panel.leyenda_colores: The three colours of the category. Green: normal, what a service needs to work (its website, its server, your account, updates, content, your home network). Orange: worth a look; it measures what you do, serves ads or nobody knows it (advertising, telemetry, measurement, ads, unclassified). Red: alert; a public list recognises it as tracking, the company is registered as a data broker, or it tries to evade monitoring. It is a way of reading the category, not a verdict: click the label to learn what it means, and block or unblock each row with its button.
panel.cat_enlace_guia: Click to learn what it means
panel.alcance_cortar_todo: It applies to the whole device, not only to the agent: the block is by name, for any program. On Windows GUARDIANA tells you afterwards which program asked, but it cannot block just one.
panel.alcance_cortar_aviso:
Guard Mode blocks EVERYTHING that is not on your list, on the whole device.

With the list as it is, {n} names would have been blocked in the last day: {ejemplos}.

If you work on this machine, you lose those sites. Switch it on?
panel.alcance_cortar_off: Off. GUARDIANA records what falls outside the job, but blocks nothing.
panel.alcance_cortar_on: On. While the AI works, it only reaches what is on the list. Everything else is blocked and shows up here for you to decide.
panel.alcance_cortado_aviso: Blocking here stops the next attempt. It does not undo what was already sent, and it does not reach an agent that does not go through this resolver.
panel.alcance_pase: I will be away: let through for {h} h
panel.alcance_pase_activo: Temporary pass until {hora}. Until then nothing is blocked and everything is recorded.
panel.recibo_lead: The few lines you can say out loud. Every figure comes from the ledger, and every receipt says when it started counting.
panel.recibo_empresas_sin: {n} companies, none with its trade explained yet
panel.recibo_empresas_sin_uno: 1 company, its trade not explained yet
panel.recibo_evasiones: {n} attempts to leave through encrypted DNS, which this ledger cannot see inside
panel.recibo_evasiones_uno: 1 attempt to leave through encrypted DNS, which this ledger cannot see inside
panel.recibo_limite: We did not see the content. This is only who the device asked for, when, and who else went out at the same time.
panel.rafagas_lead: When a device asks for several services in the same second, it is almost always one act: you opened an app. A single row does not tell that story; the cluster does.
panel.rafagas_oficio: {n} with their trade explained (measurement, attribution, ads)
panel.rafagas_ninguna: None in the last 24 hours yet.
panel.rafagas_limite: This is what the device asked for at once. It does not say which app did it or what was sent: GUARDIANA sees names, not content.
panel.cortar_pronto_confirmar:
Block “{nombre}”?

GUARDIANA has not been on this machine long and does not know yet whether some program needs it. If anything breaks, one click undoes it under Rules.
panel.cortar_limite: Blocking a name blocks the question in this home. It does not erase what was already sent, and it does not stop anyone who already has the address saved or uses their own DNS.
panel.regla_esperado_prohibido: That cannot be blocked by category: it is system updates, time, certificates, connectivity checks, messaging and video calls. If you really want to block one of those names, create a rule with that exact name.
panel.regla_esperado_confirmar: This may leave this device without updates / without messages. Block anyway?
panel.regla_patron_invalido: Check the name or the category: it is not valid.
panel.regla_casa_solo_panel: Rules for the whole home are created only from the PC's panel.
panel.regla_creada: Rule created. Every blocked query will be recorded with this rule.
panel.modo_bloqueo_lead: By default, “that name does not exist” (NXDOMAIN). The alternative answers the address 0.0.0.0. Applied when GUARDIANA restarts.
panel.mi_reglas_lead: The rules of this device: the ones you created from here and the ones the home's panel set for it. You can undo any of them from here; nobody else in the home sees the detail of what you ask unless you share it.
panel.verify_lead: The same thing guardiana verify prints: facts, not promises. If something does not add up, it shows here.
panel.verify_limite: The signature and the public ledger only make sense for released versions. How to check by hand, without trusting the program: docs/VERIFY.md in the repository.
panel.licencia_lead: One program: 7 days free with every feature, and after that it needs a subscription. While it is active GUARDIANA watches and keeps everything; when it is not, it stops watching and puts this machine’s DNS back as it was. What was written down stays on your disk.
panel.licencia_prueba: Trial: {d} days left (ends on {fecha}). Nothing is charged; when it ends GUARDIANA stops watching until you activate a subscription.
panel.licencia_prueba_uno: Trial: 1 day left (ends on {fecha}). Nothing is charged; when it ends GUARDIANA stops watching until you activate a subscription.
panel.licencia_prueba_texto: The seven days are counted on your machine, in two places: your ledger and a separate mark that only an administrator can remove ({donde}). That mark holds the date they started and the latest time the program has seen, so setting the clock back does not stretch the trial. Nothing else. We say so here because we hide nothing we do on your machine.
panel.licencia_prueba_sin_marca: The seven days are counted on your machine, in your ledger. The separate mark that stops them from starting over ({donde}) could not be written because GUARDIANA has no administrator rights, so for now the date is only in the ledger.
panel.licencia_ancla_texto: A copy of your key, of this activation's number and of the product is also kept in {donde}, where only an administrator can touch it, so losing the data folder does not lose what you paid for. Not your name, not your email.
panel.licencia_err_clave_vacia: Type the licence key you received by email. Nothing was sent.
panel.licencia_plus_rechazada: The gateway has been saying for 7 days that the key is not valid (after a refund, for instance, or after disabling it), so the licence ended on {fecha}. GUARDIANA has stopped watching and has given the DNS back as it was; what was written down stays on your disk. If you think this is a mistake, write to hola@guardianagroup.com.
panel.licencia_prueba_agotada: The trial ended on {fecha}. GUARDIANA has stopped watching and has put this machine’s DNS back as it was: your internet works the same. What was written down is whole on your disk and you can export it. To watch again, activate your licence key.
panel.licencia_clave_lead: The key arrives by email when you pay. One connection to {host}, started by you, to activate it; then one check 8 days after activation and one per billing period (monthly or yearly; the Founder licence, paid once, one a month, so that a refund reaches this machine too). If a check cannot be done (no internet, the gateway down), it is tried again every hour until it goes through. All of them are recorded in “What GUARDIANA knows about you”. Nothing else leaves your machine.
panel.licencia_arrancando: Plus activated. GUARDIANA starts watching again in a few seconds; this page refreshes by itself.
panel.licencia_dev: This program carries the development key: it is a working build, not the released version.
panel.licencia_limite: Without a subscription GUARDIANA stops watching and puts this machine’s DNS back as it was: your internet does not break. Cancelling deletes nothing of what was written down.
panel.licencia_err_formato: The payment gateway’s answer is not in the expected format. Nothing was activated.
panel.licencia_err_clave: The gateway did not accept the key: {motivo}.
panel.licencia_err_red: Could not connect to the gateway: {motivo}. The key was not activated; the attempted connection is on record.
panel.hogar_suspension: Notice: this PC goes to sleep by itself (plugged in: {ac}; on battery: {dc}). While it sleeps, phones pointing only at it are left without DNS. Set it to “Never” in Settings › System › Power & battery › Screen and sleep, or add the router as secondary DNS on the phones.
panel.hogar_suspension_nunca: This PC does not go to sleep by itself. Good: the phones will not lose their DNS because of that.
panel.hueco: GUARDIANA was not watching between {desde} and {hasta}. It is on record.
panel.licencia_comprobacion_al_dia: Subscription: {periodo}. GUARDIANA checks the key 8 days after activation and then once per period: the next time on {fecha}; it is recorded below.
panel.licencia_comprobacion_pendiente: Subscription: {periodo}. The key is due for a check; GUARDIANA will do it on its next pass. If it cannot, it retries every hour and keeps working for 7 more days; only after that would it stop watching and put the DNS back as it was.
panel.licencia_comprobacion_fallida: Subscription: {periodo}. The key could not be checked (no connection to the gateway). GUARDIANA retries hourly; if it does not manage before {limite}, it will stop watching and put the DNS back as it was.
panel.licencia_comprobacion_no_toca: The subscription is not due for a check yet.
panel.licencia_de_por_vida: Lifetime licence: paid once, it does not expire. GUARDIANA checks the key when it can, but Plus is never switched off for a check it could not make — not offline, not with the machine off for months. The only thing that ends it is the gateway saying the key is no longer valid, after a refund for instance, and that is said here with its date.
panel.licencia_plus_cancelada: The gateway says the subscription ended on {fecha}. GUARDIANA has stopped watching and has put the DNS back as it was; what was written down stays on your disk. If a payment failed and you have sorted it out, type your key here again: GUARDIANA checks it and watches again, with the DNS and Home Mode as you had them.
panel.licencia_plus_sin_comprobar: GUARDIANA could not check the subscription during the 7 days of grace and stopped watching on {fecha}, putting the DNS back as it was. It keeps trying every hour: as soon as the gateway answers that the key is valid, it starts watching again on its own, with no need to type the key again.

panel.ia_lead: An artificial-intelligence agent on your machine works with your keys: your folders, your accounts, your network. Here you see which services it talks to, from which device and when.
panel.ia_limite: GUARDIANA checks where it talks, not the content. It sees service names; it does not see the files a program opens nor what travels inside each connection. What leaves through an app’s own encrypted DNS or a VPN does not pass through here either, and is recorded when detected.
panel.ia_servicios_titulo: AI services seen in the last 7 days
panel.ia_servicios_lead: From our open list of artificial-intelligence services. One showing up does not mean it is doing anything wrong: it means that device looked it up.
panel.ia_sin_servicios: No AI service seen on this machine yet.
panel.alcance_lead: You gave an agent permission for a task. Write here which services it needs for that. With Guard Mode off, GUARDIANA only shows you what went beyond that list; with it on, it blocks and brings each name here for you to decide.
panel.alcance_nuevo_lead: One service per line. The domain and everything under it counts: writing github.com includes api.github.com. Once saved it appears above, with the Guard Mode switch so it also blocks what falls outside.
panel.alcance_lineas_malas: I cannot read these lines as the name of a service: {lineas}. Write just the name, for example github.com or api.openai.com (a whole address, with https://, works too).
panel.alcance_borrado: Scope removed: this device has nothing declared again.

panel.alcance_fuera_uno: 1 name beyond what was declared in 24 hours
panel.alcance_fuera_ninguno: Nothing beyond what was declared in the last 24 hours.
panel.alcance_esperado_nota: System updates, time, certificates, connectivity checks and recognised messaging never count as “beyond”: they belong to the machine itself, not to the agent.
panel.alcance_limite: This checks destinations, not intentions: it says which services a device tried to reach, not what it did with them nor which files it opened. An agent working only with files on your disk does not show up here, because it asks for no name.
panel.hogar_mac: Home Mode is not part of version 1.0 on a Mac: GUARDIANA does not manage the macOS firewall and we have not tested it here the way we did on Windows and Linux, so we do not vouch for it yet. The site says the same.

panel.caducado_texto: GUARDIANA has stopped watching and has put this machine’s DNS back as it was: your internet works exactly as before. What is already written down stays on your disk, whole, and you can take it whenever you like.
panel.caducado_dns: The trial or the subscription has ended: GUARDIANA is not watching, so it does not point the DNS at itself. Activate Plus to watch again.
panel.caducado_hogar: The trial or the subscription has ended: GUARDIANA is not watching, so it does not switch Home Mode on. Activate Plus to watch again.
panel.caducado_hogar_relevo: Home Mode was on and your router still sends the house's queries here: so that nobody is left without internet, GUARDIANA keeps passing them on, without looking at them or writing them down, while this computer is on. Put the router's DNS back as it was (or to automatic) when you can.
panel.prueba_franja_texto: After that GUARDIANA stops watching and puts the DNS back as it was; what was written down stays on your disk.
panel.licencia_err_inactiva: The gateway knows the key, but it is not active yet: the subscription is waiting for its first payment (or the payment failed). As soon as the gateway records it, type the key here again and it activates.
panel.licencia_err_limite: This key has already been used on every computer it allows. To free one or add more, write to hola@guardianagroup.com with the key: it is sorted out the same day.
